gloss: to panic; to lose one's head

definitions.gloss: to panic; to be flustered; to lose one's head
definitions.explanation: To become extremely agitated and confused, losing the ability to act calmly. Stronger than simply being surprised — implies visible confusion and disorganized behavior.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{皆|みんな}が{慌|あわ}てふためいた。
examples.english: Everyone panicked because of the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {財布|さいふ}がないと{気|き}づいて{慌|あわ}てふためいた。
examples.english: I panicked when I realized my wallet was missing.

examples.japanese: {突然|とつぜん}の{来客|らいきゃく}に{慌|あわ}てふためいて、{部屋|へや}を{片付|かたづ}け{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Panicking at the unexpected visitor, I started tidying up the room.

notes:
USAGE:
{慌|あわ}てふためく emphasizes a state of extreme panic and confusion. It is stronger than {慌|あわ}てる alone, which simply means to be in a hurry or flustered. The ふためく part intensifies the sense of disoriented panic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慌|あわ}てふためいて{逃|に}げる (to flee in a panic)
- {慌|あわ}てふためく{様子|ようす} (a panicked appearance)

RELATED WORDS:
- {慌|あわ}てる: to be flustered, to rush
- うろたえる: to be confused and agitated
- {取|と}り{乱|みだ}す: to lose one's composure
